thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=\"inference-hosting-prod\" — high 5xx rate detected. Escalation policy attached: policy-plat-sched (routes to @platform oncall).

pagerduty-bot: Incident #INC123456 created and triggered. Urgency: high. Attempts: initial page sent to schedule 'platform-eng-schedule'.

emma (oncall): acked. I'm on it — grabbing context. :eyes:

emma (oncall): quick check — PD shows this is routing to the platform schedule, not SRE. That seems wrong for inference-hosting-prod. Can someone confirm expected escalation?

raj (sre): that's wrong. inference-hosting-prod should use escalation policy 'sre-inference-ep' -> schedules SRE oncall. Did we recently change PD mappings?

dylan (platform): I pushed a PD automation change in the maintenance window earlier that remapped several services to a unified 'platform-eng-schedule' for ops automation. I thought inference-hosting-prod was excluded — looks like it wasn't. possible config drift. sorry.

christine (customer-success): heads-up: we just got a support ticket from AcmeCorp reporting timeouts for LLM generation around 08:07 UTC. They've escalated to account team. No broad customer page yet.

emma (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) ack and contain alerts to avoid paging wrong folks; 2) mute platform schedule for this incident to stop cascading pages; 3) reassign escalation policy on PD to correct 'sre-inference-ep'; 4) coordinate post-fix handoff.

emma (oncall): executing mute for platform schedule now:
```bash
# mute schedule: platform-eng-schedule for 30m
pd schedules update platform-eng-schedule --mute 1800
```

pagerduty-bot: platform-eng-schedule muted for 30 minutes by emma.

emma (oncall): reassigning service -> ep mapping (will update service record to point to sre-inference-ep). Doing via PD web UI to be safer.

raj (sre): while emma updates PD, I'm running quick checks on nodes. hypothesis: spike in mem pressure triggered 5xx from the runtime pool. Pulling logs.

emma (oncall): PD updated: inference-hosting-prod now points to escalation policy 'sre-inference-ep'. I'm sending a manual page to SRE so they have the incident in their timeline.

pagerduty-bot: Manual notification sent to schedule 'sre-oncall' by emma. Incident timeline appended.

raj (sre): got it. I'll take primary. Observing elevated latency and a flurry of eviction logs on worker-14. Suspect batching backlog + OOMs on quantized model worker.

dylan (platform): re: automation change — I'll roll back the PD script and add a safety exclusion for inference-hosting-prod. Also adding a unit test to the PD config deploy so service->ep mappings can't accidentally flip.

christine (customer-success): I pinged AcmeCorp and told them our oncall is investigating, ETA ~15m. They said it's impacting 2 of their production jobs. Keep me posted if we need to escalate to SLA team.

emma (oncall): next steps recorded: 1) platform mute in place to stop noisy pages; 2) PD mapping corrected; 3) SRE (raj) owning mitigation; 4) platform (dylan) reverting automation change + test; 5) cs (christine) handling customer comms.

raj (sre): mitigation underway: draining worker-14, restarting inference process, rolling OOM-kill threshold up temporarily, and warming up spare workers. If that doesn't drop 5xx rate in 5m, fallback to the smaller model variant.

emma (oncall): thanks. planning an on-call handoff at 09:00 UTC; I'll stay on until then for coordination. After we stabilize, let's run a quick postmortem focused on PD routing tests and automation gating.

dylan (platform): I added a pre-deploy validation to our PD infra pipeline: it now rejects changes that touch services tagged 'prod-inference' unless approved by SRE. Will monitor commit.

raj (sre): 5m update — 5xx rate trending down, worker restarts succeeded. Still seeing higher queue depth but no new OOMs. Rolling back temporary config once stable.

christine (customer-success): AcmeCorp updated — they see job success now. Thanks team. They want a short incident summary when resolved.

emma (oncall): incident declared resolved at 08:18 UTC from paging perspective. We'll keep PD incident open for follow-up tasks and postmortem.

emma (oncall): action items captured: - PD: add exclusion for 'prod-inference' to platform automation - SRE: postmortem with timeline + mitigation - Platform: add unit test for service->ep mapping and revert change - CS: customer summary for AcmeCorp - Ops: verify no other services were unintentionally remapped

dylan (platform): noted. I'll open a PR with the fix + test and tag @raj for review.

emma (oncall): thanks everyone. tagging the handoff: @dylan (platform) will own the infra follow-ups, @raj will own the SRE postmortem, @christine will own customer comms. Leaving thread for async follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
